messages:
Nina: Quick follow-up from today — roadmap highlights: kernel improvements, multi-tenant batching fairness, and a KV cache eviction change proposal. Recording: https://redwood.example.com/all-hands/2026/runtime-brief. Drop clarifying q's here.

Omar: On eviction: are we switching from LRU to segmented-LRU to favor hot tenants? Concern about noisy neighbors.

Priya: Yes proposal is SLRU with per-tenant quotas. Hot sets get fast lane, cold items demoted. Admins can set tenant_quota_pct. Default quota aims to protect small tenants.

Leo: For batching fairness, will we enforce per-tenant max_batch_size or use weighted scheduling? Some customers saw their short chats delayed.

Priya: Weighted fair batching is planned: weight by tenant priority and recent latency. Config knobs: weight_window_ms and min_share_pct. We'll publish defaults and a tuning guide.

sre-bot: kernel-canary deployed -> cluster-delta at 1811234605 (traffic 4%)

Nina: On-call runbook request: can someone draft quick rollback steps if eviction bugs surface? I can own the doc.

Omar: I'll draft by EOD. Steps: 1) toggle eviction_policy=LRU, 2) reduce cache size for affected cluster, 3) restart cache nodes with graceful drain, 4) monitor kv_cache.latency and tenant_error_rate.

Nina: Perfect. Planning office hours about batching & eviction tomorrow 1pm PT. See you there.
